title: Case study panel
purpose: Desktop off-canvas panel that renders a full case study over the listing.

content.budgetRule: Budgets are COUNTS measured from the rendered clone at 1440px (extraction/measured-values.json copyBudgets); copy itself is never stored. maxWords/maxChars = the maximum observed across every route that renders this section; list sizes = observed min/max. Shorter is allowed; longer is rejected.

heading.basis: inherited from hero.article: the panel renders the same case-study content component (StudyContent), which is not in the DOM until a card is opened

lead.basis: inherited from hero.article: the panel renders the same case-study content component (StudyContent), which is not in the DOM until a card is opened

media[].alt.basis: inherited from hero.article: the panel renders the same case-study content component (StudyContent), which is not in the DOM until a card is opened

assets.note: reference mode may use referenceRoles (evidence); generated mode must use generatedRoles (generation-safe only, pinned in code). See assets/asset-roles.json.

style.note: token props take token-catalog names only (tokens/llm/token-catalog.json); allowed values per section are listed in tokens/llm/token-policy.json styleProps.

runtimeUi: fixed off-canvas panel slides in from the right over a blurred backdrop
closes on Escape or backdrop click; only rendered at desktop widths
retrievalIneligibleReason: Off-canvas dialog opened by clicking a card; it renders the case-study detail content that the article sections already describe and is never a retrievable section in its own right.
